high_level_description: This image is a promotional poster for the Tamil film "Annaatthe," starring Superstar Rajinikanth. The poster features a vibrant and celebratory atmosphere with a mix of traditional and modern elements. Main Subject: The central figure is a man dressed in a traditional white dhoti and shirt, wearing sunglasses and a confident posture. He appears to be in mid-stride, with one hand on his hip and the other slightly raised, suggesting a dynamic and powerful stance. His expression is joyful and triumphant, with a wide smile and eyes closed, as if he is celebrating
